acceptanceCriteria.text: Switching projects or leaving a tab unsubscribes obsolete listeners, prevents stale callbacks from changing state, and does not leak reads across repeated switches.
Only fresh core data for the active screen gates readiness; inactive collections are not loaded and stale cache is not presented as current.
The map receives the complete required node and route geometry while large task, log, media, and admin collections use stable bounded queries or pagination without duplicate or missing rows.
Admin and catalog data refresh on defined events or explicit requests and do not retain unnecessary listeners while inactive.

checkpointPayload.description: Optimize project switching, active-tab realtime subscriptions, fresh core loading, complete map geometry, and stable pagination without changing shared Firebase contracts in @doc/specs/2026-08-25/web-backend-performance-optimization.
checkpointPayload.title: [web-backend-performance-optimization-02] Scope Firestore data loading to active work
